features.name: GitHub Actions Workflow Push Trigger with Concurrency Control
features.description: Triggers supervisory execution upon pushes to the main branch modifying ChatMachines/GeminiSupervisor/nextmessage/nextmessage.json, governed by a non-canceling concurrency group.

evidence.mechanic_summary: Configured to trigger only on pushes affecting `ChatMachines/GeminiSupervisor/nextmessage/nextmessage.json` on branch `main`, with concurrency group `gemini-supervisor-state-machine` and `cancel-in-progress: false`.

features.name: Automated Git Checkpoint Commit and Push of Run Artifacts
features.description: Extracts run metadata (nonce, step, gate result) from nextmessage.json and state.json, and commits updated run artifacts under ChatMachines/GeminiSupervisor/runs to the main branch.

evidence.reference_symbol_or_heading: Commit returned run state, context, and store
evidence.mechanic_summary: Uses git diff --cached to detect changes in `ChatMachines/GeminiSupervisor/runs`, evaluates trigger/state JSON using inline Node.js script to generate a commit message format `Gemini Supervisor checkpoint: <run> Step <step> <gate>`, and pushes to `origin HEAD:main`.

features.name: Workspace File Ground-Truth Deterministic Verification
features.description: Verifies repository file claims by ensuring paths are within the safe repository workspace, checking existence, directory vs file status, reading UTF-8 content, verifying git tracked and dirty status, and testing verbatim content matching.

evidence.mechanic_summary: Executes path safety check with safeWorkspacePath(relPath), fs.existsSync, fs.statSync, and fs.readFileSync; checks git tracking via `git ls-files --error-unmatch` and working tree status via `git status --porcelain`; marks status VERIFIED, PARTIAL, UNKNOWN, or NOT_EXECUTED based on existence and verbatim match of observed content.

features.name: Git Object Existence Ground-Truth Verification
features.description: Deterministically checks for the existence of 40-character SHA commits or blobs in the checkout object database using git cat-file and git show.

evidence.mechanic_summary: Invokes `git cat-file -e ${sha}^{blob|commit}` to verify git object existence; if present, retrieves commit metadata via `git show -s --format=%H%n%s` or blob size via `git cat-file -s` and marks status VERIFIED.

features.name: Live Run Container Baseline Nonce and HEAD Verification
features.description: Validates active run container integrity by checking that run nonces inside state.json, messages.json, and store.json match the triggering runNonce, and captures current git HEAD commit SHA.

evidence.mechanic_summary: Reads state, messages, and store files to verify `current_state.run_nonce` or `run_nonce` match `runNonce` yielding VERIFIED or CONTRADICTED; invokes `git rev-parse HEAD` to capture HEAD SHA as a verified finding.

features.name: Execution Return Schema Ground-Truth Claim Extraction and Deduplication
features.description: Recursively traverses return schemas to identify structured evidence records and string path/SHA claims, correlates them to file/git locators, and assigns deduplicated, numbered ground-truth IDs.

evidence.mechanic_summary: Walks returnSchema searching for objects possessing non-empty `source`, `locator`, and `observed_content` properties.
Walks returnSchema searching for strings matching relevant path keywords (evidence, completion, locator, etc.) and extracts repo paths or SHA identifiers.
Deduplicates finding records by compound key `claim_path|source|locator|claimed_observed_content` and prefixes IDs with `gt_<index>_`.
Aggregates baseline, evidence, and embedded path findings into an immutable record, flags blocking findings using BLOCKING_GT_STATUS, and assigns aggregate_status PASS or FAIL.

features.name: Deterministic Pre-Supervision Validation Message Generation
features.description: Constructs a system validation message when trigger schema inspections or deterministic live ground-truth checks encounter blocking failures, passing them as evidence into supervisory context.

evidence.mechanic_summary: Combines inspected trigger failures and blocking ground-truth IDs into a `system_validation_message` payload with numbered findings.

features.name: Granular and Ground-Truth Evaluation Template Construction
features.description: Constructs the expected supervisory gate schema structure, creating *_eval objects for all terminal execution key/values and pre-populating deterministic ground-truth claim templates.

evidence.mechanic_summary: Creates key-specific `{ [key + '_eval']: { [key]: value, supervisor_eval_result: null, supervisor_eval_comment: null } }`.
Recursively clones execution return schema into matching *_eval structures across arrays and objects.
Generates `deterministic_findings`, `claim_evaluations`, `aggregate_status`, and empty supervisor result/comment placeholders from groundTruth.
Assembles top-level `supervisory_gate` object with role boundaries, instructions, granular evaluation, ground truth evaluation, step-level evaluation, failures array, and gate_result.

features.name: Google Generative Language (Gemini) API Client Integration
features.description: Invokes the Google Generative Language v1beta generateContent API with system instructions, ground truth findings, step prompt, and a 180-second timeout.

evidence.mechanic_summary: Posts to `https://generativelanguage.googleapis.com/v1beta/models/${model}:generateContent` with API key header `x-goog-api-key`, system_instruction parts containing systemText and extra corrections, contents payload, and AbortSignal.timeout(180000).

features.name: Supervisory Model Reply JSON and Code Block Parser
features.description: Extracts and parses JSON from the model's reply parts, falling back to markdown code block extraction if raw parsing fails.

evidence.mechanic_summary: Joins part text, attempts direct JSON.parse, and regex matches fenced code blocks `/```(?:json)?\s*([\s\S]*?)```/i` before throwing a parse error.

features.name: Supervisory Gate Role and Granular Evaluation Verification
features.description: Verifies that the returned supervisory schema adheres to strict role requirements, exact execution value preservation, ground truth deterministic status immutability, and gate result consistency.

evidence.mechanic_summary: Checks `role_required`, `role_forbidden`, `role_completed`, and non-empty `role_verification.method` and `role_verification.evidence`.
Recursively verifies that execution keys/values are preserved exactly inside `*_eval` blocks and that `supervisor_eval_result` is PASS/FAIL with non-empty comments.
Enforces that deterministic findings and aggregate status match runtime findings exactly, and checks claim-by-claim evaluation records.
Disallows gate_result PASS if groundTruth.aggregate_status !== 'PASS' or if ground_truth_verification_eval.supervisor_eval_result !== 'PASS'.

features.name: Iterative Supervisory Gate Repair Loop
features.description: Provides automated retry and correction feedback loops up to 4 attempts when Gemini returns invalid JSON, failing role validation, or malformed evaluation schemas.

evidence.mechanic_summary: Loops while schema or eval validation fails, compiling specific repair instructions; records intermediate replies into messages file and aborts with an error after 4 failed attempts.

features.name: Step-Specific Context and Stated Requirements Prompt Injection
features.description: Injects Step 3 evaluation artifact (step-3-evaluation.json) and Step 2 stated requirements into supervisory prompt context when evaluating steps 3 or 4.

evidence.mechanic_summary: When step === 3, loads and stringifies `tests/step-3-evaluation.json` into system prompt; `statedRequirements` extracts `stated_requirements` from Step 2 step records and appends them to prompt for steps 3 and 4.

features.name: Procedure State Transitions and Step Record Updates
features.description: Updates step attempts and transitions procedure state: advancing to next step and marking run complete or awaiting ChatGPT on PASS, or maintaining step and setting failure state on FAIL.

evidence.mechanic_summary: Appends attempt record to `step_records[String(step)]`. If gate_result === 'PASS', moves step to `completed_steps`, advances `current_step` to next remaining step, and sets status to 'complete' or 'awaiting_chatgpt_execution'. If FAIL, maintains `current_step = step`, sets awaiting reason to 'supervisory_gate_fail', and records `last_supervisory_failure`.

features.name: Nextmessage Execution Trigger Schema Contract
features.description: Defines the input trigger contract containing run_nonce, execution source_role, step number, and return_schema with role verification, actions, and evidence locators.

evidence.mechanic_summary: Provides sample trigger JSON for run `merge_step3_tsr_evaluation_heuristic_20261001_1` at step 4 containing `source_role`, `step`, and nested `return_schema` with `Step_4` role boundaries, actions, and evidence arrays.
